neighbours.label: the noun counted by a distributive or plural quantifier: the head noun right after each / every / many / several (each card, many days, every symptom)
fire: In this game each player draws exactly seven tiles at the start.
During the drought many wells in the district ran dry by August.
The inspector checked every bolt on the bridge before it reopened.
Over the years several attempts were made to drain the marsh.
At the fair each stall sold a different kind of cheese.
There are many reasons why the bridge was never finished.
Before the launch every valve was tested twice under pressure.
In the archive several letters mention the fire of 1842.
